headline.question: Do we dispatch on time, every day, safely?
headline.answer: 95.8% of orders left on time this month. The target is 98%, and Mombasa’s forklift is most of the gap.

decisions.question: Forklift 3 in Mombasa broke down for the third time in 5 weeks.
decisions.why: It is the same hydraulic leak. New seals have been promised since 12 October.

decisions.question: The seal supplier has missed its delivery date twice.
decisions.why: It has come up 4 times since 3 October. The forklift has stood still for 6 hours so far.

decisions.question: Kisumu’s Monday trucks leave late.
decisions.why: They left late 3 Mondays in a row, but it is getting better since the coaching.

decisions.question: Nairobi’s generator test is 2 months late.
decisions.why: The power cut on 22 October lasted 3 hours, because the generator did not start.

decisions.question: Decide whether to get a backup transporter for Kisumu.
decisions.why: This has come up 3 times, and it is your decision.
